Standing at 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m), Veselý plays the [[small forward]] position, but he is also capable of playing at the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position. Veselý is now one of the most promising young players in Europe. He decided not to enter the [[2010 NBA Draft]], but he is predicted to be a lottery pick in the [[2011 NBA Draft]]. == Personal life == Jan Veselý was born on April 24, 1990 in [[Ostrava]] ([[Czechoslovakia]] then, [[Czech Republic]] now). His father, Jan, is a former basketball player, and his mother a former [[volleyball]] player.Sportal.rs: [http://www.sportal.rs/news.php?id=20552 Jan Veseli: Od Duleta sam mnogo naučio] (February 7 2010) Veselý's younger sistereKapija.com: [http://www.ekapija.com/website/sr/page/312840 Jan Vesely, košarkaš Partizana – veselje se širi na sve strane] (May 7 2010) and girlfriend Eva, who studies [[architecture]],[[Mondo]]: [http://www.mondo.rs/s208800/Sport/Sport/Kosarka/MONDO_TV-_Oprostaj_Veselog_od_Beograda.html Oproštaj Veselog od Beograda] (11 June 2011) are both basketball players.[[Mondo]]: [http://www.mondo.rs/s209292/Sport/Sport/Kosarka/Veseli_srecan_ti_put.html Veseli, srećan ti put!] (16 June 2011) Reportedly, he is fluent in [[Czech language|Czech]], [[Slovenian language|Slovenian]], [[Serbian language|Serbian]] and [[English language|English]]. == Professional club career== Veselý began playing basketball with the youth clubs of Příbor and BK Snakes Ostrava in the Czech Republic. He joined [[KD Slovan|Geoplin Slovan]] in 2007. He then moved to [[KK Partizan|Partizan Belgrade]] in 2008. He won nine club trophies with the club,[[Mondo]]: [http://www.mondo.rs/s208673/Sport/Sport/Kosarka/Pitajte_Jana_Veselog.html Pitajte Jana Veselog] (10 June 2011) and also reached the [[2009–10 Euroleague Final Four]]. In 2010, Veselý was presented the [[FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award]]. At his last match with Partizan, the final of the [[Basketball League of Serbia|2010–11 Serbian League]], the team captain [[Petar Božić]] gave Veselý to lift the winning trophy, while the audience gave him standing ovations.[[Mondo]]: [http://www.mondo.rs/s208546/Sport/Sport/Kosarka/Veseli_odlazi_presrecan_Kecman_bi_jos.html Veseli odlazi presrećan, Kecman bi još] (8 June 2011) == Czech national team == Veselý has been a member of the senior men's [[Czech Republic national basketball team]], having previously played for the junior national teams. == Technique and comparisons == Due to his speed and court movement, Veselý has been compared to [[Dirk Nowitzki]] and [[Andrei Kirilenko]].S Media.com:
